productionMode: Guided planner and scripted demonstration; live model disabled

checks: Run all bilingual evaluation cases against the exact pinned model and prompt
Have bilingual reviewers score meaning, uncertainty, negation and added advice; no severe failures
Re-run cancellation, consent, malformed output and scope tests on the deployed endpoint
Configure a server-only provider key, cost cap, distributed rate limiting and operational owner
Verify provider/hosting retention, logging and data handling with the actual project settings
Keep the working local planner available on timeout or service failure

gates.requiredBefore: Claiming validated beginner usability or adoption
checks: Run the fictional beginner tasks in research-kit.html with informed consent
Recruit people with low digital confidence; include Polish speakers
Use safeguarding and appropriate consent if minors participate; do not recruit vulnerable minors informally
Measure unprompted completion, recovery, comprehension and confusion; do not request personal account access
Fix critical misunderstandings and retest before making adoption or safety claims
Review every new message in context on phone and desktop
Review intimate-image, uncertainty, account ownership, family restrictions and file-password wording
Check destination languages and terminology against actual provider interfaces

gates.status: pending qualified reviewer and named content owner
checks: Assign a named content-maintenance owner
Review guidance and boundaries with a technology-safety practitioner
Confirm referral destinations, age eligibility and region-specific support
Treat successful link checks as reachability only, never validation of the advice

gates.requiredBefore: Claiming validated performance and usability on low-end phones
checks: Test iOS Safari and Android Chrome on physical devices
Try file download, Files picker, passphrase reveal, reopen and quick exit
Test slow connections, interrupted downloads, screen readers and 200% text scaling
Record load and first-action timings; desktop WebKit is not a physical iPhone test
